objective: Compare the reliability mechanisms available for a small research workflow engine
questions: How do worker leases support recovery?
How does idempotency prevent duplicate findings?
What benchmark latency has been measured?

sources.title: Synthetic design note — recovery
sources.content: Worker leases give a task a temporary owner. After leases expire, another worker can claim the task for recovery. A fencing token prevents an old worker from committing results after reassignment.

sources.title: Synthetic design note — data integrity
sources.content: Idempotency prevents duplicate findings when a task is retried. Unique database constraints enforce the identity of each finding. Source snapshots preserve the original text and its SHA-256 hash.
